# Comparables.ai

> > AI-powered M&A and deal sourcing platform providing market intelligence, valuation analysis, and target screening across 360M+ companies.

Comparables.ai is an AI-driven market intelligence and M&A deal sourcing platform designed for investment banking, private equity, corporate finance, and equity research professionals. The platform combines advanced AI features with comprehensive global company data to enable faster deal sourcing, valuation analysis, and competitive benchmarking.

## Key Topics

- M&A Deal Sourcing
- AI Screener
- AI Insights
- AI Analyst
- Private Equity
- Investment Banking
- Valuation Analysis
- Company Screening
- Market Intelligence
- Financial Benchmarking
- Target Identification
- Ownership Structure
- Competitive Intelligence
- 360M+ Companies Database
- AI-Powered Analysis

## Core Platform Features

- [Product Overview](https://www.comparables.ai/product): Main product overview covering AI Insights, Screener, Column, and Analyst features
- [AI Insights](https://www.comparables.ai/product/ai-insights): AI Insights feature for market comparison and trend analysis
- [AI Screener](https://www.comparables.ai/product/ai-screener): AI Screener product for high-value target identification across millions of companies
- [AI Analyst](https://www.comparables.ai/product/ai-analyst): AI Analyst for strategic reasoning and deal comparison
- [AI Column](https://www.comparables.ai/product/ai-column): AI Column feature for custom AI-powered data analysis
- [AI Relevancy](https://www.comparables.ai/product/ai-relevancy): AI Relevancy scoring and filtering for search results
- [Pricing](https://www.comparables.ai/product/pricing): Pricing page comparing Free and Premium plans

## Industry Solutions

- [Solutions Overview](https://www.comparables.ai/solutions): Solutions overview for investment banking, PE, corporate finance, and market research
- [M&A Target Screening](https://www.comparables.ai/solutions/ma-target-screening): M&A target screening across 360M companies with AI relevancy filtering
- [Investment Banking](https://www.comparables.ai/solutions/investment-banking): Investment banking solution for screening and valuation
- [Private Equity](https://www.comparables.ai/solutions/private-equity): Private equity solution for deal sourcing and due diligence
- [Valuation](https://www.comparables.ai/solutions/valuation): Valuation solution for comparable peers and multiples analysis
- [Financial Benchmarking](https://www.comparables.ai/solutions/benchmarking): Financial benchmarking for peer groups and valuation multiples
- [Equity Research](https://www.comparables.ai/solutions/equity-research): Equity research solution for peer analysis across 60K+ equities
- [Competitor Search](https://www.comparables.ai/solutions/competitor-search): Competitor search and benchmarking solution across 360M companies
